info.title: SentinelX API
info.description:
Security operations platform: ingestion, detection, correlation, investigation.

**Authentication.** `POST /api/auth/login` returns a short-lived access token; send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie and exchanged at
`POST /api/auth/refresh`. Roles: VIEWER (read only), ANALYST (+ investigation work), ADMIN
(+ users, rules, settings, audit log). The role each route needs is in docs/api.md.

**Lists** return `{"items", "total", "limit", "offset"}`.

**Errors** always have the shape
`{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"?}}`. Validation errors (422) never echo
submitted values.

post.description:
Store and normalize a batch of records for one log source (ANALYST+).

- `application/json`: `{"records": ["<raw line or JSON text>", ...]}`
- `text/plain`: one record per line (a log file as-is; NDJSON for JSON sources).

At most INGEST_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) and INGEST_MAX_RECORDS (5,000 records) per request; each
record at most 64 KiB. Records already stored for this source are counted as duplicates
and not stored again, so resending a file is safe.

AlertActivity.title: AlertActivity
AlertActivity.description: A status change, from the audit log.

AlertSummary.title: AlertSummary
AlertSummary.description: One row of the alert queue.

AssetUpdate.title: AssetUpdate
AssetUpdate.description:
Hostname is the asset's identity for enrichment, so it cannot change: retire the asset
and register the new name instead.

Disposition.title: Disposition
Disposition.description: Why a RESOLVED alert was closed (brief §45: confirmed / resolved).

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The shape of every error response (app/core/errors.py).

EventPage.title: EventPage
EventPage.description:
Keyset pagination: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next (older) page.
There is no total: counting a month of events on every page would be wasted work.

Exclusion.title: Exclusion
Exclusion.description: Events matching an exclusion are ignored by the rule (an allowlist entry).

RawRecordPublic.title: RawRecordPublic
RawRecordPublic.description: A stored raw record. `text` is for display only: undecodable bytes show as U+FFFD.

RuleChanges.title: RuleChanges
RuleChanges.description: What an admin may send. Only fields the rule declares tunable are accepted.

SourceType.title: SourceType
SourceType.description: Which parser produced the event (one per supported input format).

SourceUpdate.title: SourceUpdate
SourceUpdate.description:
The source type cannot change: records already stored were parsed as that type.
To parse a different format, create a new source.

UserPublic.title: UserPublic
UserPublic.description: What the API ever reveals about a user. There is deliberately no password field.
